result.summary: SCOPE: in scope -- new tenant-data access path. Letflow.Definitions.validate_definition_graph/2 and the new run_semantic_validation/2 helper (called from activate/2) each now issue a fresh Letflow.Engine.VariableSchema.fetch_schemas/3 read (tenant-scoped variable_schemas table) and feed it plus the Graph into the new pure Letflow.Definitions.SemanticValidation.validate/2. INV-1 and INV-6 apply per security-invariants.md's applicability note (checkable diff touching a tenant-scoped table's read path). INV-4, INV-7, INV-8 checked as always-live. INV-2/3/5/9 not applicable (no API response shaping, no scripting sandbox, no lookup-by-ID endpoint, no outbound HTTP). Verdicts: INV-1 APPLIES/PASS -- (a) fetch_schemas/3 requires and enforces a non-empty :prefix (validate_prefix/1, lib/letflow/engine/variable_schema.ex:470-475) and issues repo.all(prefix: prefix) (line 344), never a default/public-schema read; both new call sites (Definitions.validate_definition_graph/2 and the new run_semantic_validation/2) pass through the same prefix already threaded through get_by_id/2 (which itself validates prefix via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 before any Repo.get, lib/letflow/definitions.ex:571-580) -- no new prefix-resolution mechanism introduced, existing convention reused correctly. (b) no migration in this diff -- variable_schemas is a pre-existing table, not newly created here. (c) variable_schemas carries no tenant_id column at all (per its own moduledoc, Decision 0006 D2 -- schema-prefix-only scoping), so there is no caller-supplied tenant_id field to mis-attribute; not applicable. definition_id passed to fetch_schemas/3 is always definition.id from the already prefix-scoped fetched row, never a bare caller string. INV-4 APPLIES/PASS -- no secret material read, logged, or serialised anywhere in the new code; grep for System.get_env/hardcoded-secret patterns over the changed files returns nothing relevant. INV-6 APPLIES/PASS -- this SECURITY-REVIEWER handoff itself is the required proof-of-scoping artifact for the new fetch_schemas/3 call sites. INV-7 APPLIES/PASS -- grep for Repo.query over the three changed files hits only pre-existing lines outside this diff (e.g. definitions.ex:1536, unrelated to REQ-372); the new code path uses only Ecto.Query (from/2, VariableSchema's existing parameterised query) with zero raw SQL. INV-8 APPLIES/PASS -- grep for bare '{:ok, ...} =' matches over the three changed files hits only pre-existing lines outside this diff; the new code uses typed with/case chains throughout (validate_definition_graph/2's with-chain, run_semantic_validation/2's nested case on fetch_schemas/3 and SemanticValidation.validate/2, interpret_activate_result/1's new explicit pass-through clauses for the two new error shapes -- no catch-all added, consistent with INV-8's own exhaustive-matching guidance). The two hd(path) calls in semantic_validation.ex (field_existence_violations/3, operand_family/2) are safe by construction: {:var, path} nodes only ever originate from Expr's parser via String.split(ident, ".") on a non-empty lexed identifier, which never returns [] -- same 'immediately after a value the same function already validated' exemption INV-8 itself carves out.
